tenderSchedule.title: Annual maintenance of PWD Sub division at Doddaballapura taluk

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shell be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority before use on the work.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labor welfare fund.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original, Submit the original document at the time of technical bid opening or next day and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval.

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Bangalore Division, BANGALORE during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value, it will be calculated as per the STD tender document Attached.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
Tenderer who qualifies in the technical bid such tenderers financial bid will be opened.
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials before using the same to the work.

Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum, the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost. Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment.

When Structure constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing bunds, Structure and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public /private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder.

If the Successful Bidder has quoted lesser rates than the estimated rates then he should without fail remit the Unbalanced Tender Amount along with the Security Deposit within the stipulated time as that shall be specified in the Letter of Acceptance, failing which the tender of the Successful Bidder shall be rejected.

All the items of work as Maintained in the Bill of Quantity (BOQ) are including lead and lift charges loading and unloading charges labour charges all incidental charges hire charges of all machinery and equipment required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per standard technical specification and directions of Engineer in charge of the work.
Terms and condition of Contract as per Approved STD KW-1

Uploaded original BG or EMD to be submitted to The Executive Engineer, PWD Bangalore Division, Bangalore before the date of opening of the tender otherwise tender will be rejected for non-submission of EMD.
Period of Completion is 03 Months & further the road should be kept pothole free up to 12 Months from the date of Work Order
Contractor shall be Class-IV & Above

Progress of Work will be reviewed monthly / at the end of each Milestone. In case the Progress achieved falls short by more than 10% of the Cumulative Programmed, the Reasons for such Shortfall shall be examined and a Record made thereof apportioning the Responsibilities for the Delay between the Contractor and the Employer.
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The Item rates are Exclusive of GST
The rates should be quoted Exclusive of GST. (As per the GOVT Order FD 417 Exp-12/2024 Dt:09.08.2024.)
The tenderer belongs to ST to submit the address proof and Identity proof issued by Government authority i.e. any one of Voter ID / Adhar Card/ Pass Port/ Driving License etc.,
The tenderer belongs to ST should furnish the domicile certificate of this State of Karnataka for more than 10 Years . Issued by competent authority
The tenderer who Compete for this work should be ST . The Caste Certificate issued by the Competent authority should be furnished.

itemList.description: Removing white wash or colour wash by steel brushing and / or scraping, sand papering and preparing wall surface smooth including repairs to scraches including cost of labour, material complete as per specifications. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Wall  painting  with  plastic  emulsion  paint  of  approved  brand  and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade:  One  coats  on  old  work  as  per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Finishing walls with Premium Acrylic Smooth exterior paint of required shade : Old  work  (Two coats  applied  @  1.43  l/  10  m²)  over existing cement paint surface   including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Repairing  and  fixing  shutters  (panelled  or  glazed)  to  doors,  windows,
ventilators and cupboards. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Painting   with   synthetic   enamel   paint   of   approved   brand   and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade :One coats on old work as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Cleaning of under ground sump, Over Head R.C.C. Tank ( independent staging)  including  disposal  of  slit  and  rubbish,  all  as  per  direction  of Engineer-in-Charge. The cleaning shall consist  following operations:-
Tank shall be emptied of water by pumping & bottom shall be  cleaned of silt and other  deposits.
Entire surface area of the sump shall then scrubbed thoroughly with wire brush etc. and pressure washed with water.
Chlorination of RCC internal surface by liquid chlorine.
The treated surface shall be dried using air jetting and all loose particles shall be removal from the surface.
Finally the surface shall be treated with ultraviolet radiation etc. as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge. ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Providing   and   fixing   Chlorinated   Polyvinyl   Chloride   (CPVC)   pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. External work - 32 mm nominal dia Pipes ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Providing, Single Phase Submersible Pump Sets of 100mm dia (4 inch) suitable for bore well confirming to IS 8034-2000 specifications, to work site with testing of as per instructions of engineer incharge of work and latest amendments etc. complete. 3.00 HP/2.2KW 15 STG (PWD Bng circle 2023-24 SR V5 SR P No. 150 , I No. 13.9.2) ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Supply and delivery at site Brand new best make PVC insulated cable of Flat 3 core (sheathed) of nominal cross sectional area as per IS 694-1990 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments 1x3x4 Sqm (PWD Bng circle 2023-24 SR V5 SR P No. 154 , I No. 13.22.3) ---- Including all lead lifts loading unloading transportation labour hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works cost and convene of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Providing, laying and jointing HDPE pipes of specified grade and conforming to IS 4984-2016 with latest ammendments and conveying to work site including loading and unloading at both destinations and rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and jointing of pipes and specials with electrofusion welding, giving hydraulic test as per relevant ISS with all lead and lifts including encasing the pipe alround to a depth of not less than 15 cms. with soft gravel or selected
earth available from the excation, testing and commissioning. The rate is exclusive of required specials and fittings wherever necessary like saddle Tee, stub ends, flanged sets, bedns, reducers etc. complete (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) etc. complete.
